name: BARTHOLOMEW
canonical: Bartholomew, also called Nathanael, the guileless true Israelite 'in whom is no guile', a wiry man of about thirty-five with warm mid-olive skin, a candid honest open face with clear steady frank eyes and an easy half-smile, dark brown curling hair to the nape and a moderate softly-curled chestnut beard, dressed in a striped cream-and-brown woven mantle over a plain undyed tunic with a folded head-cloth resting on his shoulders, hands open and unguarded
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
